name: web
description: Scaffold, install, build, test and run Vite/React web apps.

tools.name: scaffold
tools.description: Create a Vite + React + TypeScript app in the project (or a subfolder).

path.description: Destination folder relative to the project root (default ".")

tools.name: install
tools.description: Run npm install for the web app.

path.description: App folder relative to the project root (default ".")

tools.name: build
tools.description: Run the production build (npm run build).

path.description: App folder relative to the project root (default ".")

tools.name: test
tools.description: Run the app test script (npm test -- --run).

path.description: App folder relative to the project root (default ".")

tools.name: start
tools.description: Start the Vite dev server in the background and return its URL and PID.

path.description: App folder relative to the project root (default ".")

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stop the dev server started by this extension.

path.description: App folder relative to the project root (default ".")

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check whether the dev server is running and show the last log lines.

path.description: App folder relative to the project root (default ".")
